causes.what: The cache service failed at about 18:20: hit ratio fell from ~91% to 0 and cache.resp.ms stopped reporting, while the host still answers ping. Reads now fall through to the primary database (db-01), whose CPU tripled, and this is the likely cause of the app and web slowness.

The replica has its own I/O problem that began at 18:18, before the cache failure. I/O wait went from ~5% to ~30%, replication lag rose from ~3s to 400s and CPU is at 92%. Its root cause is not visible in Zabbix.

ruled_out: nas-01 storage (latency 2.71 ms, normal IOPS, answering ping)
Network and host reachability on db-01, db-02 and cache-01 (0% loss, ping OK)
db-01 disk I/O (iowait 2.26%) and memory (56%): its load is CPU only
Disk space on db-01 and db-02 (fs.data about 62%)
Memory or CPU saturation on cache-01 (CPU 21%, mem 57%)
The cache failure as the cause of db-02's trouble: db-02 degraded at 18:18, before the cache dropped at 18:20

evidence.claim: cache-01 cache.hit.pct was 90-94% through 18:19:18, then 0 from 18:20:18 onward
cache-01 cache.resp.ms is marked STOPPED REPORTING, last value 6m ago, while icmp.ping=1 and CPU is 21%
db-01 CPU jumped from ~19-27% to 72% at 18:20:58 and stays at ~66-71%, 1 minute after the cache drop
db-02 io.wait rose from ~4.7% at 18:17 to 28.5% at 18:18:19 and has stayed at 26-34%
db-02 replication lag went from 2.7s at 18:17 to 28.5s at 18:18, then 128s, 227s, 327s and 400s from 18:22, i.e. onset at 18:18, before the cache failure
db-02 slow queries rose from 0.85 to 33 at 18:18:52, so it was already degraded before cache-01 dropped
nas-01 latency is 2.71 ms with ping OK, and no maintenance is active
app-01 app.resp.ms is 1837 ms with 0 DB errors, so the app is slow but not failing
The 12 open alerts begin at 18:20, with the db-02 CPU alert first; the app and web alerts follow at 18:21

next_step: Check the cache service on cache-01 (process, logs, memory limit and restart or crash at about 18:20) and restore it. Separately, check db-02's own storage or hypervisor I/O, since its I/O wait began at 18:18, and check whether the replica reads from storage that is not recorded in the host tags.
